notes:
**Fixes & polish**

- **iPad right-click no longer pops a second, stray menu.** Right-clicking a block on iPad (or a two-finger trackpad tap) sometimes opened Apple's *AutoFill · Ask Siri* bar alongside Infiniti's own block menu, and a hard trackpad scroll could raise it or briefly freeze scrolling. Right-click now shows only Infiniti's menu, and scrolling stays smooth. (#980; the callout is presented by WebKit's `UITextContextMenuInteraction`, now stood down while our menu is up.)
- **Backspace at the start of a bullet no longer jumps your text to the wrong place.** Pressing Backspace at the start of a bullet or to‑do whose previous neighbour had indented items used to merge your line onto that neighbour — skipping over the bullet you could actually see — and leave a stray empty bullet behind. It now joins the line directly above, and to‑dos behave the same as bullets. (#1018.)
- **Backspace no longer strands a paragraph's sub‑items at the top level.** Backspacing at the start of a paragraph or heading that has indented children, when the line above belonged to a different branch, could push those children out to the document root. They now re‑home onto the line above, as expected. (#1021; the §B+D paragraph‑child model.)
- **The "changes waiting to apply" notice reads properly on iPad.** The sync notice shown when another device sent changes this build can't yet apply was rendering as a cramped, one‑word‑per‑line card jammed into the iPad sidebar. It now appears full‑width from the sidebar bell, which shows a dot when there's something to read. (#1017; Addendum 15 §O5.)

**Under the hood**

- Added a permanent regression harness for the Backspace / forward‑Delete "structural family" — a unit matrix plus WebKit end‑to‑end cover across bullets, to‑dos, headings and B+D paragraphs — so this class of hierarchy‑corruption bug can't silently return. Also stabilised several stale/flaky journal and context‑menu end‑to‑end tests so the suite gives an honest signal. (#1022, #1024, #1025.)
